slide_guidance.title: What are these consumers searching for?
slide_guidance.guidance: Derive the three search triggers from private, listening-shaped insight (P2 太阴 with 青龙耀明: quiet audience observation yields bright material). The discovery door (P3 开门 with 癸 长生) says fresh, genuine consumer needs exist at the category's opening — frame triggers around real emerging needs, not manufactured ones. 玄武 in the same palace warns triggers built on invented behaviour will be exposed.

slide_guidance.title: Consumer Search Behaviour & Intent
slide_guidance.guidance: 开门 at 长生 supports a full-funnel query set: informational sprouts (长生 = newly arising questions) through commercial to transactional. The obstruction-gated execution channel (杜门/华盖地户) says the realistic behaviour of this audience includes quiet, niche, long-tail searching — include specific problem-phrased queries, not only head terms.

slide_guidance.title: Keyword Research & Strategy
slide_guidance.guidance: Prioritise long-tail/niche terms (P7 华盖地户: quiet planning benefits, open-front contests do not — head terms are the open-front contest). Deduplicate ruthlessly (centre 伏吟天庭: documents pile up): no two priority keywords with the same intent and target. Ground every priority in free real sources (autocomplete, related searches, Trends) — P3 玄武/地刑玄武 exposes invented volumes, matching the assignment's DON'T.

slide_guidance.title: Keyword Mapping & Website Discoverability
slide_guidance.guidance: One consolidated map: each priority keyword to exactly one page (伏吟天庭 anti-duplication). Give visibility-shaped keywords (brand, category head terms) the 景门 treatment — the display-worthy page: homepage/category. Educational queries map to the document-authority pages (天辅 star: guides, FAQs). Two blog topics should answer the 长生-phase informational queries (fresh, sprouting questions).

slide_guidance.title: Foundational SEO Strategy
slide_guidance.guidance: On-page: evidence-traceable, useful content (开门 deception-guard: no inflated claims). Off-page: document-led mentions and pitches (P1 奇仪顺遂 利文书谒贵; P8 青龙耀明 benefactors give money and effort). Technical: treat 丁奇入墓/门入墓 as the chart's own image of blocked crawl/index/message routes — audit indexation, mobile paths and information routes first; the loudest content fails if the routes are entombed. No forced over-optimisation: 伏干格/飞干格 penalise blunt pushing.

slide_guidance.title: Digital PR Objective & Consumer Insight
slide_guidance.guidance: Objective: establish credibility and visible authority — the querent sits with 值符+天辅+景门 (the presiding charter star of documents/education in the visibility gate). Insight: from private listening (太阴) — what the audience quietly struggles with but does not say publicly. Brand connection and desired outcome should point at shared, participatory visibility (P9 六合).

slide_guidance.title: The Big Digital PR Idea
slide_guidance.guidance: The chart's strongest signature is cooperative: 六合+生门+日月并行 ('especially favours cooperative affairs')+青龙合会 ('partnership benefactors') in the south/visibility palace. Build a participation/co-creation concept — the community helps make or complete something — not a solo announcement. PR-worthiness qualities the chart backs: HUMAN + CULTURAL (六合 participation), DATA-LED if the P8 research asset is the campaign's backbone. 帝旺 caution: cap the hype cycle; extremes reverse.

slide_guidance.title: Digital PR Campaign Execution
slide_guidance.guidance: Timeline: Pre-Launch = quiet gated build (杜门/华盖地户: embargoed seeding, long-tail content, private community cultivation). Launch = handed to the P9 engine via partners, in a visibility window (tradition-conditional 午-peak symbolism). Amplification = slow, grounded, iterative passes (九地; 太白退位: detours and repositioning are the expected shape, 门生宫: invested effort returns). Two creative assets: research-report cover (P8 document formation) + campaign key visual or social creative for the co-creation mechanic (P9).

slide_guidance.title: Media, Creator & Community Outreach
slide_guidance.guidance: Pitch with documents to established voices (P1 九天 + 奇仪顺遂 利文书谒贵 + 星随月转: attaching to a patron advances). Expect cold-start slowness (死门+门迫宫): pitch patiently, revive dormant contacts, sequence follow-ups. Choose relevance over fame (the chart nowhere rewards blast radius without substance; P8 惊门 warns controversy-bait). Formalise creator/partner terms explicitly — hidden 螣蛇夭矫: loose partnerships dissolve into quarrels.

slide_guidance.title: Digital PR Amplification Strategy
slide_guidance.guidance: Amplify through partners and communities (六合) rather than brand-only blasting: earned → owned → shared flows mirror the chart's sequence quiet-channel(P7) → visibility-engine(P9) → grounded persistence(P8 九地). Verify each channel's route is un-entombed (丁奇入墓) before pushing volume through it.

slide_guidance.title: Integrated Discoverability Strategy
slide_guidance.guidance: One sequenced loop, not two parallel blasts: the 壬/庚 seat-exchange shows querent and matter interlocked and mutually draining when forced simultaneously. Route A (search-led): need → 开门 discovery → document pages → brand. Route B (PR-led): partner activity (六合) → coverage → interest → branded search → site. Both converge on the same consolidated content layer (centre dedup directive) and hand off to each other at defined points.

slide_guidance.title: Measurement & Key Recommendations
slide_guidance.guidance: Six KPIs via the symbolic frame (assumption-indexed): 景门→search impressions/visibility; 开门→organic sessions/discovery; 生门→conversions/sign-ups; 六合→brand mentions/shares/participation; 杜门→indexation/coverage gaps (technical); 惊门+天芮→sentiment spikes and defect monitoring. Three SEO priorities: consolidate & deduplicate (C010), long-tail low-competition targeting (C006), unblock technical routes (C009). Three PR priorities: cooperative participation concept (C005), data/document-led asset (C009), patient document-based pitching to real relevant voices (C008). Strategic conclusion: credibility built quietly, then made visible together with partners.
